name: a-stones-throw
description: Throw rocks into a lake: dispersive ripples, crown splash and Worthington jet in WebGL

scripts.test: node tools/run-probes.mjs fish-probe.mjs ice-probe.mjs ring-probe.mjs gale-probe.mjs thing-probe.mjs foam-probe.mjs "skip-probe.mjs 30" garden-probe.mjs tropics-probe.mjs visitor-probe.mjs visitor-wave-probe.mjs cavity-probe.mjs spray-probe.mjs fft-test.mjs drop-ring-probe.mjs wave-probe.mjs load-asset-test.mjs jet-probe.mjs rain-probe.mjs snow-probe.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check:cpu && npm run check:controls && npm run check:site
scripts.check:controls: node tools/controls-probe.mjs && node tools/screen-probe.mjs && node tools/frame-rate-probe.mjs && node tools/grab-probe.mjs && node tools/uniform-probe.mjs
scripts.check:site: node tools/quality-probe.mjs && npm run site && node tools/site-check.mjs && node tools/site-check.mjs --webkit && node tools/startup-probe.mjs
